data.body: Done definition update: Add Done sub-item — CLAUDE.md rule 18 (Never bypass review gate / --no-verify) is reconciled with enforcement.strategy=ci semantics in the same commit as the flip. Either (a) rule 18 is amended to state that under ci strategy --no-verify is permitted because CI enforces, with explicit reference to the parity-uplifted llm-review job, OR (b) review-gate.sh PreToolUse continues to block --no-verify even under ci strategy and rule 18 is unchanged. Choose (a) or (b) before the flip; do not leave it ambiguous for ed9c-a277 to resolve later. (From adversarial review)
